method: Independent review of the generated reference graph, original source records, preserved data, actual hint/menu route helpers and explicit wiring-family membership. Existing reviewed manual evidence is reused; no new full-manual or physical-panel verification is claimed.

modelScope: Eight-zone CFP Standard front fascia and Main Control PCB — DFU7001020 Rev 2 / DFU7004010 Rev 1
K11080M2 eight-zone K-series; sigma_CP 214.hex or later warning scope — Man-1078 Issue 25

boundaries.conventionalMapType: Physical controls and documented configuration functions; no invented LCD tree.
boundaries.nanoOlderEngineering: V2.xx commissioning references retain their source edition and do not gain V3.xx interactive routes solely from a shared label.
boundaries.wiringMembership: Every original page is included once in an explicit family collection. Family grouping is for browsing, not an electrical compatibility claim.

findings.finding: The former onsite catalogue ignored confidence:reference for 31 Vigilon runtime nodes, so reference-only topics could receive a guided route.
findings.resolution: Onsite hints now consume the reviewed global map and shared route guard. Independent regressions reject every original reference runtime ID as an interactive route; the conflicting Repair and reference-only PIN topics remain discoverable without HINTS links.

findings.finding: The existing Orisec picture family includes CP-200 although the legacy trainer sources exclude it; several Premier Elite picture variants point to an Elite 48 fixture.
findings.resolution: Context help exposes the exact trainer edition/scope and explicit CP-200 exclusion / Elite 48 fixture notice, preserving the existing model data.

findings.finding: The first projection attached task routes to kind:reference call-out rows, which the shared guard correctly rejected.
findings.resolution: Authored call-outs are classified as practice actions and remain explicitly distinct from manufacturer menu screens; declared and usable fire hint-route counts now agree.

findings.finding: The first shared search treated level3 as a bare numeric code query, yielding a three-minute delay instead of access-level references.
findings.resolution: Fire-specific access-level and alphanumeric control/code queries preserve context. Independent queries now find the relevant CFP/Sigma level 3 entries, SW8, Ad, d1 and exact 2A. Bare numeric lookup semantics remain covered by existing tests.

sourceSpotCheck.result: All inspected text footers match printed pages98–106 to their one-based PDF indices. Page 98 was also rendered and visually inspected. Its appendix names EN54 (V4) Vigilon MCC/MCB V4.53+ and retains model-dependent/option-dependent route conditions.
sourceSpotCheck.notClaimed: No rereview of every cited source page in this release.

preservation.practiceRule: Only generated top-level version may change; all remaining practice data has a canonical semantic hash.

ownChecks.scope: Independent focused tests. Root runs the full regression/build and QA performs browser/offline acceptance separately.

limits: Entry totals include editorial branch groupings, values, source references and authored practice tasks; they are not counts of hardware screens.
Original nine keypad maps and fire source data remain untouched; the new maps project already documented material.
Only an explicitly supported route receives interactive hints. An unsupported archive panel retains manual lookup rather than an invented engine.
This source/logic review does not certify field wiring, physical keypad operation, iPhone Safari or publication.
